description: (Na)₂YCuBr₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a YCuBr₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the YCuBr₆ framework, Y is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form YBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CuBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Y-Br bond lengths are 2.78 Å. Cu is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form CuBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent YBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Cu-Br bond lengths are 2.65 Å. Br is bonded in a linear geometry to one Y and one Cu atom.
